entities.name: GroEL chaperonin
observations: The 541-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry A9KSJ1 from Lachnoclostridium phytofermentans.
Belongs to the Cpn60_TCP1 chaperonin family; Pfam Cpn60_TCP1 (PF00118.30) spans residues 22–521.
Forms a tetradecameric complex of two stacked heptameric rings and interacts with co-chaperonin GroES.

entities.name: GroEL ATP-dependent folding
observations: Functional reaction annotation: ATP + H2O + an unfolded polypeptide → ADP + phosphate + a folded polypeptide.
The ATP hydrolysis drives conformational cycling and encapsulation of non-native proteins; GroEL does not chemically modify the client polypeptide.
Reaction wording is a functional summary of the chaperone cycle rather than a conventional substrate-specific enzyme reaction.

entities.name: GroEL sequence properties
observations: Length 541 aa; calculated molecular mass 57,061.9 Da; theoretical pI 4.97; predicted charge at pH 7 is −15.32.
These are sequence-derived estimates for the unmodified monomer and do not account for oligomerization or bound ligands.
